sections.text: Hallo zusammen, Hello everyone, die Besprechung am Montag ist leider verschoben. Monday's meeting has unfortunately been postponed. Wir treffen uns jetzt am Dienstag um 14 Uhr im Raum 3. We now meet on Tuesday at 2 pm in room 3. Bitte bringt eure Zahlen vom Oktober mit. Please bring your figures from October. Wer keine Zeit hat, sagt mir bitte bis Montag Bescheid. Whoever has no time, please let me know by Monday. Viele Grüße Best regards Die Teamleiterin The team leader

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: A model text, written for this course. A real one names people: replace them with placeholders before you save it. verschoben is the participle of verschieben : to postpone. In Germany, times at work are written with the 24-hour clock: 14 Uhr is 2 pm.
